_comment: meant: the Jev question (criteria are filled in by VoiceQuery, one per option). kinds: how each option is described to Jev. filler: words of a spoken search that get no playlist lookup of their own.

meant.instructions: Someone spoke a search into the remote of a TV app that holds live channels, a TV guide, movies and series, mostly in German. A speech recogniser wrote down `heard`: its guesses, best first. It often mishears names, abbreviations (HSV, BVB, DAZN), team names and English titles in German speech, and may add words like "zeig mir". `options` are those guesses plus names from the app that sound or read alike. Which option did the person most likely want to search for? Prefer a name from the app when it plausibly sounds like what was heard; keep a heard guess when none of the names is meant.

kinds.channel: a live TV channel in the app
kinds.programme: a TV programme in the app's guide
